CLASS GYMNAST STANCE

You flow from spin to strike like a cyclone of limbs and grace.

Prerequisites Acrobatics 10 ranks

Action 1 AP

While in this stance:

- If you critically succeed on a Tumble or Escape check, you may make a Strike action as a reaction.

- You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to DB against opportunity attacks.

Partly automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules. While in it, a critical success on a Tumble or Escape check asks whether to spend your reaction on a Strike (the multiple attack penalty as for any Strike on your turn). The +2 circumstance to your DB against attacks of opportunity is for the GM to add by hand: the system's defence rows cannot yet tell an attack of opportunity from another Strike (Block 11 audit, B11-6).
